name: Strange Attractor Cloud
desc: A dense, glowing Peter de Jong strange-attractor point-cloud whose silky indigo-to-gold filaments accumulate 40-70k iterates per frame into a log-density buffer and morph forever as their coefficients drift and precess — rendered as silk, psychedelic plasma, molten ember, deep-sea bioluminescence, or a graphite pencil study.

density.doc: iterate count + splat density (higher = denser, brighter cloud)

morph.doc: how much the attractor coefficients wander (filament morph amount)

style.doc: render philosophy: indigo->gold silk / psychedelic spectrum / molten heat ramp / deep-sea glow / graphite pencil (mono, abstracted)
